data.name: Fazlaah
data.gender_notes: Fazlaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic context, Fazlaah refers to the reward given by Allah (God) to those who strive in His way. It signifies the surplus blessings and rewards bestowed upon the righteous. The name Fazlaah carries the meaning “Excess, surplus, reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fazlaah usually hope their child will grow to embody excess, surplus, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To receive abundant blessings and rewards from Allah.
data.etymology: Fazlaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Excess, surplus, reward.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fazlaah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: فضلاة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من فضل، يدل على الزيادة في الخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من الفضل، ويدل على الزيادة في الخير والكرم، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "والذين هم على صلاتهم يحافظون" (المعارج: 34)، وقد أطلق على النساء الفضليات اللواتي يتميزن بالخير والصلاح

in_urdu.name: فضلہ
in_urdu.meaning: خیر و کرم میں اضافہ، نیکی و خوبی
in_urdu.long_meaning: علم مؤنث، عربی زبان سے ماخوذ، معنی خیر و کرم میں اضافہ، نیکی و خوبی، فضل اللہ کے معنی ہیں، جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی رحمت و کرم کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ روایتی نام کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फ़ज़्ला
in_hindi.long_meaning: स्त्रीलिंग नाम, अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अच्छाई और अच्छाई में वृद्धि, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक रूप से प्रयोग किया जाता है, जो इस्लामी मूल्यों और संस्कृति को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: فضله
in_pashto.meaning: په خير او نيکي کې زياتوالی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ښځو نوم، د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی، معنی یې په خير او نيکي کې زياتوالی، د افغاني او پښتني مسلمانو لخوا کارول شوی دودیز نوم دی، کوم چې د اسلامي ارزښتونو او کلتور څرګندونه کوي

in_english.name: Fazlaah
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from Arabic root 'Fadhala', meaning to increase, abound, or excel in goodness and righteousness, referenced in the Quran as a quality of believers (Al-Ma'arij: 34), symbolizing virtues like generosity, kindness, and spiritual growth

data.cultural_impact: The name Fazlaah holds a significant cultural impact as it is a reminder of the blessings and rewards that come with hard work and dedication, particularly in the religious context. It encourages individuals to strive for excellence and to constantly strive in the way of Allah for the betterment of their community and themselves, knowing that their efforts will be rewarded with bountiful blessings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Fazlaah is a name that carries the promise of Allah's endless mercy and generosity. It serves as a source of inspiration and motivation, encouraging individuals to remain steadfast in their faith and to seek the pleasure of Allah through their actions. The name serves as a reminder that no effort is too small or insignificant in the eyes of Allah, and that every good deed will be rewarded with surplus blessings in this life and in the hereafter.
